relationships.subject: postherpetic neuralgia
relationships.evidence_quote: Of the 9 biomarkers evaluated, 3 (Alpha2AR, CB2, and ETA) tested as significantly lower on the ipsilateral biopsy compared with the contralateral biopsy across the cohort

key_findings: Nine keratinocyte biomarkers (incl. CGRP, CB2, TRPV1) were differentially expressed between ipsilateral and contralateral PHN skin; CB2, Alpha2AR and ETA were significantly lower ipsilaterally.
Cohort split into distinct subgroups, supporting biomarker-guided personalized topical therapy.
